authoredPack.author: Kenney
authoredPack.name: Minigolf Kit
authoredPack.texturePolicy: Original relative GLB texture URI is preserved and the original color map ships locally. No remote runtime downloads.

physics.name: cannon-es
physics.collisionPolicy: Authored GLB world-space triangles form static collision meshes. The blind cup bottom is omitted from its collision mesh so the ball can physically fall through the real authored opening into a deeper catcher. Walls, obstacle and inclined authored ramp remain actual colliders.
physics.strokePolicy: Each stroke applies a real rigid-body impulse from selected angle and strength. Gravity, contact friction, restitution and continuous rolling resistance govern the result. Completion requires the physical ball center to fall beneath the hole.

originalContent: Three original short hole layouts, sea-side diorama placement and lighting, aiming line, direction/strength controls, actual stroke counts and independent bests. No copied commercial game map or artwork.
